title: Apexspace button
description: A square-cornered link button with a 12px uppercase monospace label and a small arrow. Four looks: signal-yellow, black, a full-width bar in a product tone, and an underlined bar. On hover the filled ones turn transparent with a dotted border (0.4s), the tone bar's text lightens and the underlined one turns yellow.
notes: tone bars read the product colours from chart-1 … chart-4
name: apexspace-button

props.name: label
props.description: the button text, set in uppercase mono

props.name: variant
props.description: primary = yellow · dark = black with a hairline · tone = full-width bar in a product colour · line = full-width with a yellow underline

props.name: tone
props.description: which product colour a tone bar uses (chart-1 … chart-4)
